results_before_optimizations.note: Phase 5 initial code had basic kernel integration without advanced optimizations

optimizations_implemented.name: Async CUDA Streams
optimizations_implemented.description: 3-stream pipeline: compute + H2D transfer + D2H transfer
optimizations_implemented.details: Streams allow overlapping GPU computation with host-device memory transfers

optimizations_implemented.name: Pinned Host Memory (DMA)
optimizations_implemented.description: cudaMallocHost for host buffers to enable DMA transfers
optimizations_implemented.details: SoA_Vec3_Pinned structure allocates both device and pinned host arrays

optimizations_implemented.name: Grid-Stride Loops
optimizations_implemented.description: Replace fixed iterations with dynamic stride to utilize full GPU
optimizations_implemented.details: Kernels use (blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; idx += gridDim.x * blockDim.x)

optimizations_implemented.name: Warp-Level Reductions
optimizations_implemented.details: Force reduction using warp shuffles, atomic write only once per warp

optimizations_implemented.name: Shared Memory for Lists
optimizations_implemented.details: Shared buffer for warp-tile data caching in force kernel

optimizations_implemented.name: Memory Coalescing (SoA Layout)
optimizations_implemented.description: Structure-of-Arrays layout for optimal memory access patterns
optimizations_implemented.details: Separate arrays for x, y, z coordinates instead of float3 structs

optimizations_implemented.name: Kernel Pipelining
optimizations_implemented.description: Frame N compute while N+1 transfers, frame N-1 results return

optimizations_implemented.name: Register Optimization
optimizations_implemented.description: Limited max registers per thread (128) to maximize occupancy

optimizations_implemented.name: Fast Math Mode
optimizations_implemented.description: Enable FP operations with relaxed precision (-ffast-math)

optimizations_implemented.name: Loop Unrolling
optimizations_implemented.description: Automatic loop unrolling via compiler optimization
